test_mtls_security: run the mTLS security test to verify mutual TLS between client and server
test_tls_security: run the TLS security test to verify one-way TLS between client and server
test_plaintext_fallback: run the plaintext fallback test to verify client and server fallback to plaintext
test_mtls_error: run the mTLS error test to verify client fails when server expects mTLS cert
test_server_authz_error: run the AuthZ error test to verify client rejects server with mismatched SAN name
